title: cert.rs: is_ca_cert ignores KeyUsage keyCertSign
description: is_ca_cert() checks only BasicConstraints.cA. RFC 5280 §4.2.1.3: if KeyUsage is present, keyCertSign MUST be asserted for a CA cert. A cert with BasicConstraints.cA=true but KeyUsage that explicitly omits keyCertSign would pass chain validation incorrectly. Trigger: a CA cert that has BasicConstraints.cA=true but lacks keyCertSign in KeyUsage (unusual but valid per RFC 5280 conformance testing).
